Unit 1 · Vowel Teams ee ea
1 Learn (Track 01)
Listen and repeat. Trace the letters and read the words.
bee, sea

A Listen and repeat. (Track 02)
Tip: ee and ea make the same long e sound: bee, sea.
bee, tree, jeep, seed, peel, green, sea, tea, leaf, meat, seal, peanut

B Find the words on the record. Then write the words.
The words run round the record.
Pictures: leaf (example), bee, peanut, green, tea, jeep, meat, tree, sea

C Circle the right word. Then write the picture number.
peenut / peanut (example: peanut, 3) · tee / tea · seed / sead · seel / seal
tree / trea · peel / peal · jeep / jeap · leef / leaf

D Listen and write the missing letters. Then check the right picture. (Track 03)
1 _ea___
2 _ee_
3 __ee_
4 _ea_
5 _ee_
6 _ea_

E Listen and write the missing word. Then write the picture letter. (Track 04)
Words: bee, sea, tea, jeep, tree, leaf
1 Look! A green snake naps under the ___. (example: tree, b)
2 A big blue whale swims in the ___.
3 The bear rides in a red ___.
4 The fox paints a green ___.
5 A little ___ lands on the red rose.
6 The old king has a cup of ___.

F Fill in the missing vowel teams. Then write the words on the matching drum.
gr__n (example: green), s__l, l__f, m__t, s__, tr__, b__, p__l
Drums: ee, ea

G Read the sentence. Trace and write the words.
1 The leaf is green. (example)
2 The seal has a peanut.
3 The bee is on the tree.
4 A (picture) is in the tea cup.
I finished Unit 1!

Audio and Credits
Listen: this book has 47 audio tracks (MP3). The track number in each headphone tag, for example Track 07, matches the file name Book5_Track07.mp3. Find the files in the Audio folder of your download. Play them on any phone, tablet or computer, as often as you like. Press play, listen, pause, then answer. Most tracks are played twice. No audio yet? Teachers can read the scripts aloud from the Teacher's Guide.

Jurassic English Phonics
Book 5 · Vowel Teams and Bossy R
Jurassic English Phonics is a five-book series that helps young learners read and spell English with confidence.
In Book 5, children learn vowel teams like ee, oa, ai, ow and oo, and Bossy R sounds like ir and ar, through songs, games and stories.
8 themed units, 2 review units and a Challenge · Listening tracks, word games and picture stories · A test and key vocabulary list at the back
The series: Book 1, Book 2, Book 3, Book 4, Book 5
by Matthew Goslee · WorldWise Learning · www.jurassicenglish.com
